title: Agu Seguí: Paper Mono zine with page flips and grid-line graphic design
note: Paper flip and grid lines graphic design style inspo. Agu Seguí (founding brand at Paper, prev Daylight and Basement Studio) shared spreads Oliver designed in Paper, posted 2026-10-09: a Paper Mono type-specimen zine in periwinkle blue, hot pink and navy, with pixel checkerboards, crop marks, monospace body copy and big headlines like 'MAKE THINGS THAT OUTLAST YOU' and 'for the love of design'. Pages flip in 3D over a light grid-line background. 14.6 s video with sound. Thumbnail is a frame from the video.
